title: Persist the Qoder device id so a same-account re-login keeps the binding
hypothesis: A fresh browser login for the same account must not orphan every existing session: the account digest may key on installation identity, not on a random device id minted per login.
measurement: Offline: rotom/extensions/qoder unit suite, 278 passing including new device-id lifecycle and re-login fingerprint cases, plus runtime/distribution 29. Live: the seeded ~/.pi/agent/qoder-device-id (0600) reproduces the stored credential fingerprint, so the two local sessions bound to it stay valid; no live re-login was performed.
result: One Qoder installation id is reused across fresh logins, so the same account keeps its sessions while a different account or organization still changes the binding. 254 local sessions bound to the previous per-login id stay unbound by design; they need a new session.
